crossRefs.note: All men have looked on it. Man sees it afar off.

translations.web: All men have looked on it. Man sees it afar off.
translations.bsb: All mankind has seen it; men behold it from afar.
translations.kjv: Every man may see it; man may behold it afar off.
translations.asv: All men have looked thereon; Man beholdeth it afar off.
